name: obsidian-exam-plugin
description: Render exam questions as beautiful interactive cards with XML format support

scripts.deploy: npm run build && PLUGIN_DIR="${VAULT_HOME:-$HOME/Documents/knowledge-vault}/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-exam-plugin" && mkdir -p "$PLUGIN_DIR" && cp main.js manifest.json "$PLUGIN_DIR/" && echo "✅ deployed to $PLUGIN_DIR (请在 Obsidian 中重新加载插件)"
scripts.release: npm run build && mkdir -p release && cp main.js manifest.json release/ && cd release && zip -r ../obsidian-exam-plugin.zip . && cd .. && rm -rf release

author: zengjing
